source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary:
Round 1 is usually paired at random. For later rounds, pair teams by these criteria in order:

1. Team Points (wins, losses and draws).
2. Total individual wins of all team members over the rounds so far.
3. At random among teams still ranked level.

recommendedOrder: each team’s total individual match wins across rounds
